# Electron Builder

Returns the YAML content required for electron-builder updates and generates `*.yml` feed metadata.

## Response Format

- YAML configuration files (`latest.yml`, `latest-mac.yml`, `latest-linux.yml`).
- Compatible with the electron-builder / `electron-updater` update mechanism.

## Generated Files

| Generated File | Purpose |
|----------------|---------|
| `*.yml` | Contains package information and update metadata for electron-builder |

## Checking for Updates

```bash
curl -X GET 'http://localhost:9000/checkVersion?app_name=myapp&version=1.0.0&channel=stable&platform=windows&arch=amd64&owner=admin&updater=electron-builder'
```

## Upload with the `updater` Parameter

Include the `updater` parameter so the binary and `*.yml` land in an isolated folder:

```bash
curl -X POST --location 'http://localhost:9000/upload' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/myapp.exe"' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/latest.yml"' \
--form 'data="{\"app_name\":\"myapp\",\"version\":\"0.0.1\",\"channel\":\"stable\",\"publish\":true,\"platform\":\"windows\",\"arch\":\"amd64\",\"updater\":\"electron-builder\"}"'
```

For macOS, upload the whole build output of one architecture in one request — `latest-mac.yml`, the `.zip`, the `.dmg` and both `.blockmap` files:

```bash
curl -X POST --location 'http://localhost:9000/upload' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/latest-mac.yml"' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/myapp-0.0.1-arm64-mac.zip"' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/myapp-0.0.1-arm64-mac.zip.blockmap"' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/myapp-0.0.1-arm64.dmg"' \
--form 'file=@"/path_to_file/myapp-0.0.1-arm64.dmg.blockmap"' \
--form 'data="{\"app_name\":\"myapp\",\"version\":\"0.0.1\",\"channel\":\"stable\",\"publish\":true,\"platform\":\"darwin\",\"arch\":\"arm64\",\"updater\":\"electron-builder\"}"'
```

`electron-updater` updates macOS apps from the `.zip` and uses `.zip.blockmap` for differential downloads; the `.dmg` is for first installs from your download page (see [`/apps/latest`](../api/info/fetch-latest-build)). The `.dmg.blockmap` is not used, but uploading it is harmless — several `.blockmap` files per platform and architecture are accepted.

Files are then organized as:

```
/updater/myapp/stable/windows/amd64/0.0.1/
├── myapp.exe
└── latest.yml
```
